title: Restricted matrix iteration
statement: For a real matrix $A$ indexed by $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ and a subset $B$ of those indices, define a sequence of vectors in $\mathbb R^n$ as follows: the initial vector has coordinate $1/n$ on $B$ and $0$ outside $B$. Each subsequent vector is obtained by applying the linear map associated with the matrix whose rows outside $B$ are zero and whose rows in $B$ agree with $A$.
